$comment: Mechanical guardrails for FacilityIQ. Rules are data so they can be extended without editing the scripts. Each rule cites the Notion standard it enforces and the in-repo skill that explains it. Standards: Coding Conventions, Unit Test Standards, CI Process, SDLC Best Practices, GitFlow. In-repo companions: AGENTS.md, .cursor/rules, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. develop does not exist; base stays origin/main until a maintainer creates develop.
protectedNote: Protected paths need GUARD_SCOPE=infra (a reviewed infra change) or an infra-only diff. .env.example is intentionally not protected: Coding Conventions §8 requires documenting new variables there. Secret env files stay protected and unreadable.
ratchet: Guards fail only on new violations in changed files (count above the base branch). Existing debt is reported by pnpm guard:baseline, which exits 0.
newDependencyPolicy: A dependency add or version change fails unless GUARD_ALLOW_DEPS=1 (human reviewer, CI label deps-approved).

importRules.message: A 'use client' file must not import services, repositories, the database, or server-only modules. Server Actions in @/server/actions are the allowed adapter. Pass serializable props from a Server Component.
Routes and pages are thin. No Drizzle or SQL here. Call one service.
Route handlers call services, never repositories.
Pages, layouts, and UI components call services. Queries stay in repositories.
Layering goes routes to services to repositories. Repositories never reach upward.

deprecated.message: Pages Router data fetching. Use an async Server Component that calls a service.
next/router is Pages Router. Use next/navigation.
next/head is Pages Router. Use the metadata API or generateMetadata.
In Next 16, params and searchParams are Promises. Type them as Promise<...> and await them.
Async Client Component. Keep data fetching in a Server Component. Async event handlers are fine.
Never return raw error.message or stacks. Throw AppError and let toErrorResponse shape { error: { code, message } }.
